acip: MA SKYES DGRA'I MDO LAS, MTSAMS MED BYED PAS DAM PA'I CHOS 'DI THOS NAS 'JUG CING MOS NA, DE'I LAS DE LAS KYI SGRIB PA YIN ZHES NGA MI SMRA'O,,
wylie: ma skyes dgra'i mdo las, mtshams med byed pas dam pa'i chos 'di thos nas 'jug cing mos na, de'i las de las kyi sgrib pa yin zhes nga mi smra'o
english: And the Sutra of Ajata Shatru says as well, Suppose a person has committed one of the immediate misdeeds, but then begins to learn these high teachings, and believe in them. I do not say that the karma of such a person could ever be a karmic obstacle.
